sam_dev: Heads-up — CI linkcheck failed for PR #412 when building the Python SDK page. mdx parser blew up on the fenced code block and there's a missing local image reference. Full CI snippet below.
deploy-bot: [CI] build/docs — failure
[ERROR] mdx-js/parse: Unexpected indent in fenced code at docs/reference/sdk/python.md:45
[WARN] Broken link: ./assets/images/sdk/main-diagram.png -> 404
[WARN] Skipping page: docs/reference/sdk/python.md due to parse error

maria_docs: Oof. Found this before — often caused by a triple-backtick + 4-space indent inside the fenced block. Can you paste the snippet around line 40? Also the image path should be under `static/img/` on Docusaurus or `docs/assets/` depending on the site root.

sam_dev: Pasted snippet:```python
    def generate(prompt):
        # sample usage
        client = RedwoodClient()
        return client.generate(prompt)
```
Looks like I indented the whole block when copying from the notebook. I'll un-indent and push. For the image, the repo currently has `docs/assets/images/sdk/main-diagram.png` but the markdown uses `./assets/images/sdk/main-diagram.png` which the linkchecker resolves from the page dir and fails in CI. Should change to `/assets/images/sdk/main-diagram.png` or reference `../assets/...` depending on build.

jordan_md: Quick options: 1) Move images to `static/img/sdk/` and reference `/img/sdk/main-diagram.png` for Docusaurus (stable). 2) If we want to keep `docs/assets`, update mkdocs/mkdocs.yml `extra_css`/`site_dir` mappings — but easier to move and update the markdown. Also add a short test to linkcheck CI to fail on 404s but not treat local relative anchors as fatal during preview.

maria_docs: Agreed on moving to `static/img/sdk/` — we use that pattern for product diagrams. Also please wrap the code fence as:```python
def generate(prompt):
    # sample usage
    client = RedwoodClient()
    return client.generate(prompt)
```
(note: no extra leading spaces before the triple backticks). I can add a tiny CONTRIBUTING note about copy-pasting from notebooks to strip leading indentation.

sam_dev: I'll open a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/418 — contains: un-indented codeblock, moved image to `static/img/sdk/`, and updated markdown to `/img/sdk/main-diagram.png`. cc @maria_docs for review. Also added a one-line test to `ci/linkcheck` to treat 404s as failures for images.

maria_docs: Nice. Quick thought — the linkchecker currently ignores anchor hashes on redirecting images; worth adding a test for `mdx` parse errors (unexpected indent) so we fail fast. I'll add a follow-up PR to CI if this merges.

jordan_md: LGTM once CI passes. If you want a rollback plan, add a fallback image path using HTML `img` tag with `onerror` pointing to `/img/placeholder.png` — but not necessary right now.

sam_dev: Thanks — merging after green. :shipit: 

maria_docs: TY! I'll open the small docs note after merge so others avoid the notebook-indent trap. :sparkles:
